reference.consistencyRule: All six faces at a node must depict exactly the same geometry, furniture, lighting state and materials from one camera origin. Adjacent nodes must preserve object placement and architectural sightlines.

acceptance: Full 360 yaw and near-180 pitch coverage
No furniture duplication or disappearance across face seams
Door/window positions match the approved plan
Lighting direction and reflections remain continuous at seams
Readable fine material detail on high-DPI phones
Hotspots correspond to real spatial exits and sightlines
